item.title: Folio 0.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • Encrypted iCloud sync between Macs: set up with a once-shown recovery code, key enrolment through iCloud Keychain, sync status in Settings, the shelf footer and the menu, Sync now.
  • Developer-signed builds (Hardened Runtime) on CloudKit's Production environment.
  • Automatic updates: the app checks the public releases feed daily and offers new versions; *Check for Updates…* in the status menu checks now.
  • Releases are built and published by GitHub Actions: pushing the vX.Y.Z tag tests, builds a notarized Developer ID DMG, publishes it and updates the appcast; a dry-run dispatch proves the pipeline without publishing.

Changed

  • Renamed to Folio: the app bundle is Folio.app, the repository cagriy/folio, the update feed cagriy/folio-releases. The bundle identifier, data folder, Keychain items and CloudKit zone are unchanged, so an existing library carries over.

Fixed

  • Settings hides granted permission requests and updates permission status live.
